feasible_observational_domains.planet_domain: Omega_hp = observational interval/censoring constraints for each measured coordinate

competing_explanations.statement: alpha_h is explained by tested observed stellar/system coordinates
competing_explanations.attack: discovery host-CV + tail stress + outer validation
competing_explanations.defense: allow multivariate combination of predeclared known host axes selected discovery-only

competing_explanations.statement: alpha_h is the ratio between effective stellar luminosity implied by catalogue insolation and luminosity reconstructed from composite R_star,T_eff
competing_explanations.attack: break the algebraic identity, sibling L_eff coherence, or held-out sibling prediction on fresh self-consistent data
competing_explanations.defense: S_catalog*a^2 defines L_eff and lambda_h=L_eff/L_RT exactly; sibling planets estimate L_eff without using the held-out target

competing_explanations.statement: the effective-luminosity representation gap is caused by shared host/source/calibration provenance
competing_explanations.attack: require the gap to persist when pl_insol, a, R_star and T_eff come from one self-consistent PS solution
competing_explanations.defense: PSCompPars explicitly permits mixed sources and archive-calculated values; common host L_eff is expected from a shared luminosity source

competing_explanations.statement: the effective-luminosity representation gap contains a missing physical stellar coordinate not represented by tested R_star,T_eff and other host axes
competing_explanations.attack: explain L_eff/L_RT using provenance/method/source variables or remove the luminosity gap in self-consistent PS
competing_explanations.defense: predict sibling planets and survive fresh self-consistent host-level data

competing_explanations.statement: f_R contains planet-local mass/radius/regime physics after host state is removed
competing_explanations.attack: within-host outer transfer after host centering
competing_explanations.defense: restrict to predeclared regimes and propagate censoring/uncertainty

predictions.prediction: for a held-out planet in a multi-planet host, log(S_catalog/S_phys) is predicted by the median log scale of the other planets of that host
predictions.falsification: fresh validation hosts show no improvement over the discovery-global scale baseline
predictions.defense: estimate alpha_h from sibling planets only; never use the held-out target

predictions.prediction: sibling planets of a host admit a nonempty common alpha_h interval after uncertainty/censoring propagation
predictions.falsification: fresh self-consistent hosts produce empty common alpha_h domains beyond declared uncertainty
predictions.defense: propagate full observational intervals and one-sided limits without point imputation

predictions.prediction: if alpha_h is reducible to tested known stellar coordinates, at least one discovery-stable explanation or discovery-selected multivariate model transfers to validation hosts
predictions.falsification: all tested known-axis explanations fail discovery robustness or outer transfer
predictions.defense: allow discovery-only multivariate ridge combination of all predeclared host axes

predictions.prediction: for a held-out sibling planet, L_eff=S_catalog*a^2 estimated from the other planets predicts its catalogue insolation better than the composite R_star,T_eff luminosity baseline
predictions.falsification: the lambda identity fails or sibling-inferred L_eff loses validation-host predictive gain
predictions.defense: freeze L_eff estimator to sibling planets only and preserve the causal-origin claim boundary

predictions.prediction: a genuine planet-local f_R term remains predictive after within-host centering on new hosts
predictions.falsification: candidate gains reverse after within-host centering on validation hosts
predictions.defense: retain regime-local scope and censored feasible domains rather than demanding a global effect
